about.body.intro_1: {app_name} fetches BibTeX entries from DOIs, arXiv IDs, and known journal URLs. It is a simple utility to quickly convert identifiers into usable BibTeX records.
about.body.intro_2: QuickBib uses doi2bib3 as its backend for DOI to BibTeX conversion.
